items.exampleEn: Let's go shopping at the mall this weekend.
items.exampleZh: 我們這個週末去購物中心逛街吧。

items.exampleEn: This jacket was a real bargain.
My wallet is full of receipts.
items.exampleZh: 我的皮夾裡塞滿了收據。

items.exampleEn: This restaurant is good and inexpensive.
I can't find the receipt for these shoes.
items.exampleZh: 我找不到這雙鞋的收據。

items.exampleEn: We buy fresh fish at the market.
items.exampleZh: 我們在市場買新鮮的魚。

items.exampleEn: How much does this shirt cost?

items.sentenceEn: I can't find my wallet anywhere.
items.sentenceZh: 我到處都找不到我的皮夾。

items.audioEn: The night market is open every day, and the food is inexpensive.
items.audioZh: 夜市每天都有開，而且食物很便宜。

items.sentenceEn: Can I have the receipt, please?
The cost of the trip was not high.

items.stemEn: These shoes were only ten dollars. What a ____!
items.stemZh: 這雙鞋只要十塊錢，真划算！

items.stemEn: This old lamp only ____ me five dollars.
items.stemZh: 這盞舊燈只花了我五塊錢。

items.passageEn: Last summer, Amy traveled to Italy. Every morning, she visited a local market, where the fruit was fresh and inexpensive. One day, she found a beautiful scarf for only ten euros. What a bargain! But later, at a big mall, she lost her wallet. Luckily, a kind shop worker found it and gave it back to her.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，Amy 去義大利旅行。每天早上她都會逛當地的市場，那裡的水果新鮮又便宜。有一天，她只花十歐元就買到一條漂亮的圍巾，真划算！可是後來在一間大型購物中心，她弄丟了皮夾。幸好有一位好心的店員撿到，還給了她。

questions.questionZh: 在購物中心發生了什麼事？

items.promptZh: 去日本玩一趟要花多少錢？
referenceEn: How much does a trip to Japan cost?
What is the cost of a trip to Japan?
rubricZh: 「要花多少錢」可寫例如 How much does … cost?、What is the cost of …?
cost 當動詞時，問句用 does … cost

items.promptZh: 我在找一間不貴的旅館。
referenceEn: I'm looking for an inexpensive hotel.
I am looking for an inexpensive hotel.
rubricZh: 用 inexpensive 表示「不貴的」，放在名詞前（例如 an inexpensive hotel）
inexpensive 開頭是母音，前面用 an
「在找」可寫，例如 am looking for、want to find 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：「東西很便宜」：原文是 the food is inexpensive（食物便宜），中譯擴大成「東西」，且題目問的正是「食物」；宜作「而且食物很便宜」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "夜市每天都有開，而且食物很便宜。"（原 "夜市每天都有開，而且東西很便宜。"）；「東西」改「食物」，忠於原文

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：過嚴：「放名詞前時冠詞用 an」會把 the inexpensive cafe、inexpensive hotels 等正確寫法判錯；宜改「用不定冠詞時要用 an（例如 an inexpensive hotel）」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "用不定冠詞時要用 an（例如 an inexpensive hotel）"（原 "放名詞前時冠詞用 an（an inexpensive…）"）；照建議放寬
